description: Windräder (Schleswig-Holstein) is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Selection of objects with the attribute Windrad from the data of the ATKIS® Basic DLM in Schleswig-Holstein. The basis of the basic DLM is the ATKIS® object type catalog (ATKIS®-OK). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Wind turbines (Schleswig-Holstein)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Windrad, Windenergie, GDIMRH, Wärme, Schleswig-Holstein, Strom. The listing shows 2025-01-07 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
